Not a duplicate of P5875 (Mozdok-Tbilisi, 271 km DN720) or P0751. Caveat: the operator lists two separate lines in opposite naming and the sheet carries one row: a sibling string may be untracked, and 257 km / 820+1020 mm remain uncorroborated.
